speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC).

The combination of long-term smoking history, abstinence from alcohol, ultrasound findings of a thickened gallbladder wall without stones, and classic obstructive jaundice symptoms strongly suggests an inflammatory condition of the bile ducts rather than simple cholelithiasis or alcoholic hepatitis. I recommend an MRCP or ERCP to visualize the biliary tree for the characteristic "beaded" appearance before we discuss treatment options.
